title: biomes.collateral/1
description: data/biomes/collateral.json: the collateral tables (docs/world/collateral-run.md; WorldCollateral), on the arena's structure mass since CD-05. budget and ceiling: four shares of it by tier; eventAllow: four shares by tier for each set-piece kind (slide, chain, landslide, quake, catastrophe); massRef: the reference arena's structure mass (the meters' mass gains are times this over the arena's own); meterNorm: retired with the people it divided by. Every key required. Version field: schema. Policy: closed except keys starting with an underscore.

budget.description: Casualties per rolling 60 s by tier 1 to 4, shares of the people present at the stage start

ceiling.description: Cumulative casualties by tier 1 to 4, shares of the people present

slide.description: What one slide may borrow beyond the window, by tier

chain.description: What one chain may borrow beyond the window, by tier

landslide.description: What one landslide may borrow beyond the window, by tier

quake.description: What one quake may borrow beyond the window, by tier

catastrophe.description: What one catastrophe may borrow beyond the window, by tier

bystanders.description: Bystanders: how far people scatter, how fast and how often they are flung, how soon they are up (docs/design/bystanders.md)

massRef.description: The structure mass of the reference arena: the meters' gains by mass are times this over the arena's own mass at its start

meterNorm.description: What the meter gains per casualty are divided by
